name: torwache
description: A dead-simple website blocker for Chrome. No tracking, no syncing, no nonsense.

scripts.typecheck: wxt prepare && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.extension.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.tools.json
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && npm run website:build && vitest run --config vitest.e2e.config.ts
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run website:build && vitest run && vitest run --config vitest.e2e.config.ts
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run website:check
scripts.package: npm run check && wxt zip && node tools/checksum.mjs
